origin.description: Kolm's inequality measure for a numeric vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: Scale of the exponential gaps. NULL uses 1.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values first. If false, any missing value makes the result missing.

origin.details: Log of the mean of exp(parameter * (mean(x) - x)), divided by the parameter. Large gaps overflow the exponential to infinity.

translation.description: Kolm's inequality measure for a numeric vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values. Missing values are NaN.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: Scale of the exponential gaps. None uses 1.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values first. If false, any missing value makes the result NaN.

translation.details: Log of the mean of exp(parameter * (mean(x) - x)), divided by the parameter. Large gaps overflow the exponential to infinity.
translation.example:
from ineq.measures import Kolm

# generate vector (of incomes)
x = [541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261]
print(Kolm(x))
